sources.entry: SuperCmd - Open-source launcher with Raycast-compatible extensions, voice workflows, text-to-speech, memory, and AI actions. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/SuperCmdLabs/SuperCmd)

summary.one_liner: SuperCmd is an open-source macOS launcher built on Electron and React that runs Raycast-compatible extensions and adds dictation, text-to-speech, AI actions, and memory.
use_cases: Launch apps and run Raycast-style extensions from one shortcut
Dictate text by holding a hotkey and speaking
Chat with or get inline AI suggestions from OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, or Gemini
Manage clipboard history and text snippets
Tile and resize windows with keyboard commands
Migrate settings from a Raycast backup
how_to_run: git clone the repository, then cd SuperCmd
notable: Ships a @raycast/api and @raycast/utils compatibility shim so existing Raycast extensions can run unchanged
Imports encrypted Raycast .rayconfig backups locally, including hotkeys, snippets, quicklinks, and extension preferences
Speech recognition runs on-device through Whisper, Parakeet, or native macOS STT
Uses 11 Swift helper binaries for macOS-native hotkeys, window management, and snippet injection
Supports multiple AI providers plus Supermemory-backed memory
caveats: macOS only; the native Swift modules do not build on Linux or Windows
Requires several macOS permissions (Accessibility, Input Monitoring, and optionally Microphone, Automation, Calendars) and may need a restart after granting them
Development setup needs Node.js 22+, Xcode Command Line Tools, and Homebrew, and npm run dev does not build the native helpers
The first launch may show an unidentified-developer warning unless the app is opened through System Settings
